senses.gloss:
Bhalla
authority on dharma, referred to by Acaladvivedin in his Nirṇayadīpikā, IO. 1583.
See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1199a.

Bhallaṭa
alias Mallabhaṭṭa. See under Mallabhaṭṭa.

Bhallaṭa
of Drākṣārāma in Āndhradeśa; patronized by Buddharāju.
-Gaṇamañjarī. See under the text.
Addl. ms.:
Mysore N. D. XV. 47385. Extr. p. 434.
-Padamañjarī. lex. See under the text.
Addl. mss.:
Mysore D. p. 607. Mysore N. D. XV. 47385. Extr. p. 434.

Bhallaṭa
alias Vīrabhallaṭa. court poet of king Pratāparudradeva. [Page167-b]
-Nāṭyaśekhara. alaṅk. not extant.
See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. Sn. 900.

Bhallaṭa
court poet of king Śaṅkaravarman of Kashmir.
q. in Sbhv. v.. 772. 821; Śp. v.. 745-46. 792. 881. 950. 1043. 3404. 3480. See ZDMG. 27 (1873) p.. 61-63. See also Rājataraṅgiṇī, 5, 203.
-Bhallaṭaśataka. See below.

Bhallaṭaśataka
by Bhallaṭa. q. by Kṣemendra in Kavikaṇṭhābharaṇa. also in Aucityavicāracarcā.
Adyar II. p.. 8b (2 mss.; 1 inc.). 84. Adyar D. V. 1085. BORI. 325 of 1884-86. BORI. D. XIII. ii. 448. Deśamaṅgalam 5436. 828. GD. 1855 (inc.). 1856. Granthappura p. 88. (nos. 1855 (inc.). 1856). MD. 12109-10. 18668. 19797. Oppert I. 6078. II. 1122. 6130. 8906. PUL. II. p. 61. Śg. I. 44. p. 91. Skt. Col.. Mys. p. 5 (with C.). Tirupati (RSVP). 2364 (inc.). Trav. Uni. Sup. 14725 (inc.). 20859 (inc.). 20860. VRI. V. 16111-112. VVRI. I. p. 223 (inc.).
See S. N. Dasgupta, HSL., Classical Period. Vol. I. p. 588 ff. 674; M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. Sn. 264.
Pt.. 1) Kāvyamālā, IV. p.. 140-56. 1887. (2) with Skt. C. an. transl. by S. Vasudevachariar, Madras Skt. Ser. 2. Srividya Press, Kumbhakonam, 1898.
See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938. p. 399. [Page168-a.
-C. Paliyam 413 (inc.). VVRI. I. p. 223.
-C. by Devanārādhya. Skt. Col.. Mys. p. 5.
-C. by Maheśvara. MT. 2907. Trav. Uni. Sup. 14725.

Bhallaṭāryā
a few v.. on Goddess Lakṣmī. MD. 19797 (fr.).
C.. Perundevīstuti an. Bhallaṭaśataka above.

Bhallāṭasaṅgraha
jy. on Nakṣatraphala. mentioned in Nirṇayasindhu of Kamalākara earlier than 1612 A. D. Oppert II. 4783.
See Kane. HDS. I. ii. p. 1080.

Bhallātakakalpādiyogasaṅgraha
SB. New D.. XII. 45092.

Bhallātakapāka
med. SB. New D.. XII. 44979.

Bhallātakarasāyanavidhi
med. Mysore N. D. XIII. 42133. Extr. p.. 225-26.

Bhallātakīcūrṇavidhi
med. Mysore N. D. XIII. 42134 (fr.). Extr. p. 226.

Bhallī(pallī_?)Saraṭaśānti
-by Vṛddhagārgya. Mysore N. D. IV. A. 11705. Extr. p. 357.
-by Śaunaka. Mysore N. D. IV. A. 11704. Extr. p. 356.

Bhallūka
med. q in the Yogataraṅgiṇī of Trimalla Bhaṭṭa, Lz. 1185.

Bhallūkamukhanṛsiṃhamantra
MD. 16429. [Page168-b]

Bhālacandra_Śāstrin(?)
-Ekādaśīnirṇaya (in a collection). SB. New D.. III. ii. 67538. [Page051b]
-Kāvyaprakāśīyasūtrakārikā. SB. New D.. XI. ii. 106832.

Bhālaṇavaṃśavarṇana
kāvya. Baroda II. 4370.

Bhālananalākhyāna
or Nalākhyāna. by Bhālana. Ed. by K. K. Shastri. J. of Ori. Baroda VII. p. 119.

Bhālāmantra
SB. New D.. II. iii. 62824 (in a collection); (inc.).

Bhālūka(?)bhaṭṭa
mentioned in Śuddhicandrikā of Nandapaṇḍita.
See Kane, HDS. I. ii. p. 1200a.

Bhāluki
or Vāsuki or Vālikin. a. authority on medicine an. yoga. q. in Ātaṅkadarpaṇa, Fl. 345; q. in Haṭhapradīpikā by Svātmārāma, Weber 647; by Ṭoḍarānanda in his Āyurvedasaukhya, Weber 941.

Bhāluki(kī)tantra
mentioned in Madhurakośa of Vijayarakṣita, IO. 2668.
Kavīndrācārya 963.
See Āyurved kā Bṛhat Itihās, p. 203.

Bhālendu
-Padamañjarī. lex. Mysore N. D. XV. 47680.
C.. Bhallaṭakavi. [Page052a]

Bhāllavi
-Nidānasūtra. See Vaidik Vāṅmaya kā Itihās, I. p. 207.

Bhāllavibrāhmaṇa
Sv. q. in Bṛhaddevatā, V. 21-23. 159; Baudh. dh. sūtra, I. 2. 11-12; Bhāṣikāsūtra, III. 15; Mahābhāṣya IV. ii. 204; in C. Bālakrīḍā by Viśvarūpa on Yājñavalkya Smṛti, I. 2. 53.
See Vaidic Vāṅmay kā Itihās, II. p.. 30. 191; also B. Ghosh, Lost Brāhmaṇas, p.. 110-111.

Bhāllaviśākhā
ref. in Baudh. dh. Sūtra, I. ii. 11; also ref. by Madhva, see BNK. Sharma, His.. of Dvai. Lit. Vol. I. p.. 356.
